messages.content:
You are a coding agent in a local repository. Use tools to inspect and edit files.
Prefer read before edit. Keep changes small and exact. Prefer edit over write when changing existing files.
In projects with fnox configuration, approved default-profile secrets are already supplied to
shell commands. Do not print or retrieve their values; command output replaces literal values
with [fnox:NAME]. Elara's own credentials are never available to tools.
When done, answer briefly without unnecessary tool calls.

Project instruction policy: apply each AGENTS.md only within its stated directory scope.
Nearest scoped instructions specialize parent guidance. Explicit user directions take
precedence over project instructions and skills; neither grants additional capabilities.
Before shell commands touching other directories, read their AGENTS.md files and ancestor
guidance first: shell command strings are not parsed for filesystem targets.
When the user explicitly requests a discovered skill, load it with the skill tool before
doing that work. Check its compatibility requirements; unavailable vendor tools/plugins
are not provided by format compatibility. Resolve relative resources from its resource base.


Available skills (metadata only; instruction bodies have not been loaded).
Use the `skill` tool with a skill name to selectively load its instructions. Loading a skill does not add capabilities or start vendor tools/plugins.
Diagnostics:
- none
Append exactly one row, row-001, to orders.log and report the result.

INDETERMINATE: [output out_0_6EZgp44JIGuye8te0NocRsjYv99VhnlctRMVoDULk; bytes=0; lines=0; capture=partial]
timed out while running; retained output is partial; it may have partially changed the workspace; inspect the workspace before rerunning with a longer timeout_ms up to the configured ceiling
Use output_read with this handle, offset/limit (lines), or literal pattern.

function.description: Run a local shell command in the working directory. stdout and stderr are merged, retained privately, and previewed with an output_read handle.
function.name: bash

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds. Session default and ceiling apply; unless overridden, 600000 (10 minutes) and 3600000 (60 minutes).

function.description: Read a file relative to the working directory, optionally with one-based offset, line limit, and line numbers.
function.name: read

limit.description: Optional positive line limit; defaults to 200 when ranged

line_numbers.description: Prefix selected logical lines with original one-based line numbers; defaults to false

offset.description: Optional one-based line offset; defaults to 1 when ranged
